mutations.name: a dependent with another open dep is listed
kills: task.done reports what it unblocks leaves out a dependent that still has another open dep

mutations.name: hidden initiatives are named
kills: task.done reports what it unblocks counts a dependent in an owner-only initiative for an agent caller

mutations.name: the warning is never pushed
kills: task.done reports what it unblocks names a dependent whose only open dep was the completed task

mutations.name: a failed scan fails the close
kills: task.done reports what it unblocks still returns the closed task, with a warning, when another initiative holds a malformed task file

mutations.name: the quiet line drops the suffix
kills: task.done reports what it unblocks appends the dependents to the quiet human line and keeps the task result shape
